note: Rated renders: scratchpad/w15 (m01-m19) and w15q (q01, q11, q19), 930x575, built from 3368ba0, compared pixel by pixel with w14/w14q (same cameras). The largest changes are in m16 (16 % of pixels), m03 (10.5 %), m10, m09, m01, m07 (4.4 %) and m17 (3.3 %). m04 changed in only 0.3 % of pixels (the latch and frame corners) and m05 in only 0.1 % (the tumblers). Lighting is noted but not scored: the upper galley compartments are still washed white (m01, m09, m12, q19). Sampling: python3 + PIL mean / p10 / p90 by luminance over boxes (x0,y0,x1,y1). Scripts: scratchpad/raterA15/samp.py and diff.py. w14-over-w15 comparison images: scratchpad/raterA15/c_*.png.

issues.detail: Bar tumblers half-rimmed opaque cups (m05, m06, q11)
issues.problem: With the cap removed, the single-sided rim ring and wall are culled at the back. Each glass shows only a front white arc over a near-black opaque body, so it reads as a dark cup rather than a clear rocks glass.
issues.evidence: raterA15/c_m05tum.png. m05 body (205,430,300,455) is about #313337. samchui_render_11 (175,345,380,370): transparent glasses with bright rims and bright bases, and the counter shows through.
issues.fix: In tumbler(): make the rim ring double-sided (or add a second, reversed ring), use a lighter grey-glass body (about '#6a6e72', low r, kept opaque) with a darker inner wall, and add a bright base disc. No full transparency is needed.

issues.problem: The frames are coplanar strokes of a single tone, with no bevel highlight or inner shadow. The red tabs sit below the top rail instead of straddling it.
issues.evidence: m04 frame (118,250,128,500) #c8beab, std 12.5, the same as w14. lalf_133 frames (20,480,300,920) show a bright left-edge highlight and a shadowed inner edge, and the latch crosses the top rail.
issues.fix: In buildAshWall: frame depth to about 0.02 with a lighter outer-edge strip (MONMAT.alu, r 0.25) and a darker inner-edge strip (two thin gQuads per side); move the latch plate up by half its height so it overlaps the top rail.

issues.detail: Welcome cabinet head height and latch shape (m03, m16)
issues.problem: The housing head is about 1 cm above the monitor, so the tag overlaps the monitor top line. The latch is a vertical ribbed rectangle in a square bulge.
issues.evidence: m03: housing top y 97, monitor top about y 106, tag y 100-128. omaat_room_32: housing top y 60, tag y 70-125, monitor top y 130. omaat_room_32 (690,380,800,500): horizontal oval with a thumb-turn in a semicircular bulge (raterA15/o32latch.png).
issues.fix: Raise the housing head by another 0.06-0.08 m; rotate the latch 90 degrees to a horizontal oval (about 0.10 wide x 0.06 tall) with a small vertical dark bar; give the bulge a rounded outer edge (gRBox radius = half its width).

issues.detail: Coarse ash remains on barAsh and the door-2 ash wall (q11, m04)
issues.problem: The fine ash now on the J lav doors was not applied to the bar doors or the door-2 ash wall.
issues.evidence: q11 bar door (290,420,330,540) std 9.6 and m04 (150,250,370,500) std 10.4, against m17 J lav door std 6.2 and samchui std 6.6.
issues.fix: Put barAsh and the ash-wall panel material on the same ashDoor layer as the J lav doors.

issues.problem: The bar counter edge is a dark slab with a grey rail where the photo has a bright aluminium band. The q01 dark wood is mauve and streaky. The insert frames are low contrast. The jump-seat straps read as rods. The bassinet bar remains. The pots are matte.
